question: Select the most appropriate option to fill in blank no. 4.
solution:
The correct answer is **realise**.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Realise **(समझना) means to become fully aware of (something) as a fact; understand clearly.

 
 
• **Example**: He did not **realise **the gravity of the situation until it was too late.
 
 
 
• **Realise **in the context of the passage implies becoming aware or acknowledging something important - in this case, that complicated sentences can be difficult for students to understand.
 
• Hence, the correct answer is **realise**.

Therefore, the correct answer is “**Option 3**”.

 

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Guess **(मान लेना) means to estimate or suppose (something) without sufficient information to be sure of being correct.
 
• **Detect **(पता लगाना) means to discover or identify the presence of something concealed.
 
• **Decide **(निर्णय लेना) means to make a choice from a number of alternatives.
